fact: ENA reports the Council of Ministers on 2026-09-28 unanimously referred the National Data Governance Draft Proclamation, a bill designed to streamline government service delivery through system interoperability, to the House of Peoples' Representatives; no number given, not yet enacted.

Fana reports the Council of Ministers, at its 59th regular meeting on 2026-09-28, approved for submission to the House of Peoples' Representatives the draft National Data Management Proclamation (a bill, no number), designed to facilitate data sharing, interoperability and reuse; not yet enacted.
